clue.text: Those whose aim is to eliminate ill-feeling

definitions.text: Those whose aim is to eliminate ill-feeling

parts.words: Those whose aim is to eliminate ill-feeling
parts.note: ill-feeling reads like resentment between people, but here it means physical sickness, which medical professionals set out to cure

explanation.surface: A description of peacemakers who try to smooth over bad blood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ill-feeling' seems to mean animosity; read literally it is feeling ill, so the people are medics.
explanation.definitionFit: Physicians treat sickness, so their job is to get rid of patients feeling unwell.

clue.text: Father holds the leader to be a coward

indicators.note: the word for father contains the other piece, as if holding it inside

parts.note: dad is an informal word for father
a star is the leading performer, the lead

explanation.surface: A dad who wraps his arms round the group's leader turns out to be a spineless man.
explanation.definitionFit: A dastard is an old word for a sneaking, cowardly person.

clue.text: Individual talking about a crazy fellow with evident hesitation

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
a hatter, as in 'mad as a hatter', is a byword for a madman
er is the sound people make when they hesitate

explanation.surface: Someone talks about an unhinged man, umming and erring as they go.
explanation.walkthrough: The Mad Hatter of Alice in Wonderland gives the saying 'mad as a hatter'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who chatters is a person forever talking.

clue.text: Overcome opposition and organise a barbecue

definitions.meaning: to beat or surpass a rival
read as two words, a do (party) held out of doors

explanation.definitionFit: To surpass a rival is to beat them; split in two, the word is a party held outside, like a barbecue.

clue.text: Stress it's for the family

definitions.meaning: a line of descent or breed, a family stock

explanation.surface: Someone blames their stress on their relatives.
explanation.definitionFit: Strain means tension, and also a lineage or breed, as in a strain of a plant variety.

clue.text: When a sportsman's beset by beasts he'll argue

indicators.note: surrounded on all sides, so the beasts enclose the sportsman

parts.note: deer are animals, beasts of the field
a bat is a cricketer who bats, a batsman

explanation.surface: A player surrounded by wild animals is ready to protest.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a batsman is often just called a bat.
explanation.definitionFit: A debater is someone who argues a case formally.

clue.text: A tyrannical 22 in office?

definitions.meaning: 22 down is a ruler, so this is an oppressive ruler
an office worker who dictates letters to a typist

explanation.definitionFit: An autocrat is a despotic ruler; in an office, a boss speaking letters to a secretary dictates them.

clue.text: Counsel give-and-take where the Right is involved

indicators.note: taken inside, so the right and is are wrapped up in the trading word

parts.note: barter is trading goods, a give-and-take exchange
taken as written

explanation.surface: Legal advice about compromise when rights are at stake.
explanation.definitionFit: Counsel is a lawyer who pleads in court, an advocate.

clue.text: Dealing rated unsatisfactory

indicators.note: the letters are not satisfactory as they stand, so they must be reorganised

explanation.surface: A business deal judged poor by reviewers.
explanation.definitionFit: Trade is buying and selling, commerce.

clue.text: Sprawled in the long grass and passed on

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other, like someone lying in the grass

parts.note: reeds are tall grasses growing by water
lay is the past tense of lie, to sprawl out

explanation.surface: Someone lay stretched out in tall grass and died.
explanation.walkthrough: 'passed on' looks like dying, but it means forwarded, as in a message.
explanation.definitionFit: A message that is relayed is handed on to someone else.

clue.text: The arts broadcast causing split

indicators.note: scattered widely, so the letters are thrown about into a new order

explanation.surface: An arts programme on air causes a rift.
explanation.definitionFit: To shatter is to break into pieces, to split apart.

clue.text: Before the end the blackguard must be cut short

indicators.note: the scoundrel comes in front of the end in the answer

parts.note: a cur is a contemptible man, a scoundrel
a tail is the end of something

explanation.surface: A villain must be stopped before he finishes.
explanation.definitionFit: To curtail is to shorten or cut back.

clue.text: The tour via italy arranged officially

indicators.note: the tour is organised, so its letters are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: An official Italian holiday itinerary has been planned.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting with authority means doing so in an official, commanding way.

clue.text: Order, but not through a middleman

definitions.meaning: dealing straight with someone, with no go-between

explanation.definitionFit: To direct is to command; a direct sale cuts out any intermediary.

clue.text: A writer about fifty in the wrong — that's material

indicators.note: the writer piece goes inside the word for wrongdoing

parts.note: a crime is a wrong, an offence

indicators.note: the writer wraps round the number fifty

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: An author in his fifties is caught in some wrongdoing, and that is the story.
explanation.walkthrough: Crimplene is a crease-resistant polyester fabric popular in 1960s and 70s Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Crimplene is a synthetic textile, a type of cloth.

clue.text: Correspondence to establish vehicle number

parts.note: to post is to station or set up, as a guard
a car is a motor vehicle
D is the Roman numeral 500, a number

explanation.surface: Instructions for registering a car's number plate.
explanation.definitionFit: A card mailed with a short message is a form of written correspondence.

clue.text: Reduced circumstances entail serving minced meat and beans

indicators.note: chopped finely, so the letters of the food are cut up and remixed

explanation.surface: Hard times mean dining on mince and beans.
explanation.definitionFit: Abasement is humiliation or degradation, being brought low.

clue.text: Means cheats being without money

indicators.note: standing outside, so the cheats surround the money

parts.note: cons are swindlers, cheats
a note is a banknote, money

explanation.surface: Swindlers end up with no cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is the old sense outside, not lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: Means as a verb: to connote is to imply or signify.

clue.text: Place manufacturing iron tubs

indicators.note: making something new, so the letters are worked into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A factory town making metal baths.
explanation.walkthrough: Surbiton is a suburb in south-west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Surbiton is a suburban town, a specific place near London.

clue.text: Search returning youth and there may well be outrage!

parts.note: to scan is to search carefully

indicators.note: coming back, so in this down clue the youth is read backwards

parts.note: a lad is a young man

explanation.surface: A hunt for a returning boy is sure to cause uproar.
explanation.definitionFit: A scandal is a public disgrace that provokes indignation.

clue.text: After parking, get to lecture

indicators.note: the arriving word follows the parking letter in the answer

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking
to reach is to get to a place

explanation.surface: Once parked, someone arrives to deliver a talk.
explanation.definitionFit: To preach is to sermonise, to lecture someone morally.

clue.text: Gunman's instruction at high noon

definitions.meaning: the order a robber barks to make victims raise their arms
at twelve o'clock both clock hands point straight up

explanation.definitionFit: Raise-your-arms is a gunman's command; at midday a clock's two pointers both point to the top.

clue.text: A Japanese cult can turn on this

indicators.note: the words are turned round and about, so their letters change order

explanation.surface: A Japanese sect might turn against this.
explanation.definitionFit: Shinto is the native religion of Japan, worshipping kami spirits.

clue.text: Ebbtide that's really nothing much

definitions.meaning: when the tide ebbs, the sea level literally falls
a trivial amount, too small to matter

explanation.definitionFit: An ebbing tide is a literal fall in sea level; the idiom means an insignificant amount.

clue.text: The chief is totally straight

definitions.meaning: a leader or sovereign, the one in charge
a measuring stick with a straight edge

explanation.definitionFit: A ruler is a sovereign who governs, and also a straight-edged strip for drawing lines.

clue.text: Major concerned with a write-up for instance

parts.note: of means about or concerning

indicators.note: in a down clue, written upwards means read from bottom to top

parts.note: eg is the abbreviation for for example

explanation.surface: An army major involved in writing a report, by way of example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Major' looks like the army rank; it is the adjective meaning adult, legally grown up.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has attained majority is legally an adult.

clue.text: The most tiresome of the French start looking in case

parts.note: du is French for of the

indicators.note: the start of the word is its opening letter only

parts.note: lest means for fear that, in case

explanation.surface: The most boring French item starts to look like a legal case.
explanation.definitionFit: Dull means boring, so the superlative is the most boring.

clue.text: Having dined in quarters, tidies up

indicators.note: the eating word goes inside the compass letters

parts.note: the compass quarters give N, E, N and S, points of the compass
ate is the past tense of eat, having dined

explanation.surface: After a meal in their lodgings, someone clears the table.
explanation.definitionFit: To neaten something is to make it orderly and tidy.

clue.text: Such liberality calls for the use of great craft

parts.note: large means big, great
SS is a steamship, a seagoing craft

explanation.surface: Generosity on a grand scale needs real skill.
explanation.definitionFit: Largess is generous giving, open-handed bounty.

clue.text: Do better than clear a little work

parts.note: overt means open, plain to see, clear
op is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: A small piece of work that clearly outperforms the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To overtop is to rise above, to surpass.
